Name: Install System Dependencies and Git
Args: sudo yum update -y && sudo yum install -y git python3-pip python3-devel gcc gcc-c++ make && sudo pip3 install --upgrade pip

Name: Clone Repository and Setup Environment
Args: sudo mkdir -p /mnt && cd /mnt && sudo git clone https://github.com/yourusername/destark.git && sudo chown -R hadoop:hadoop /mnt/destark && cd /mnt/destark && ls -la

Name: Install Python Dependencies
Args: cd /mnt/destark && pip3 install -r requirements-emr.txt && pip3 install -r requirements-spark.txt

Name: Run All FIS Models
Args: cd /mnt/destark && mkdir -p logs && python3 scripts/run_all_fis_models.sh 2>&1 | tee /mnt/destark/logs/emr_run.log
